argv: pin="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)" || exit 81; if ! git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/heads/dev; then echo 'CLONE_LOCAL_BRANCH=FETCH_FAILED'; exit 80; fi; if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$pin" FETCH_HEAD; then echo 'CLONE_LOCAL_BRANCH=DESCENDANT'; exit 0; else echo 'CLONE_LOCAL_BRANCH=NON_DESCENDANT'; exit 79; fi

pin="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)" || exit 81; if ! git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/remotes/origin/dev; then echo 'CLONE_UPSTREAM_TRACKING=FETCH_FAILED'; exit 80; fi; if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$pin" FETCH_HEAD; then echo 'CLONE_UPSTREAM_TRACKING=DESCENDANT'; exit 0; else echo 'CLONE_UPSTREAM_TRACKING=NON_DESCENDANT'; exit 79; fi
